title: Bloc 5 normalization base models and T1 base envelope -- measured field matrix
generated_by: mechanical introspection of the shipped pydantic models

convention.convention_rationale: Matches the accepted storage convention (StorageModelBase). The repository's models are validated mutable pydantic objects, so the base layer matches them rather than introducing frozen dataclasses; determinism is delivered by canonical serialization plus the canonical quality-flag ordering the envelope enforces.
convention.collections: tuples, never lists, so an envelope cannot be mutated after construction
convention.enums: inherited str Enum with value == member name
convention.datetimes: Optional[datetime], timezone-aware, UTC-normalized by the accepted coerce_utc rule
convention.numeric: Decimal for every provider-native value (no rounding, no invented precision)
convention.determinism: canonical_json_bytes: UTF-8, sort_keys, compact separators, enum string values

frozen_correspondences.why: bloc_05/03 §15 spells a blocked cause BLOCKED_IDENTITY while bloc_05/05 §12 spells the same concept IDENTITY_BLOCKED. Both are kept exactly as frozen and related by frozen read-only data, so neither vocabulary is renamed to match the other.

frozen_correspondences.why: Each member has an explicit frozen fail-closed citation. Label-only flags (archive reconstruction, dedupe candidates, unit-native-only) are deliberately excluded.

validated_opaque_types.why: validated non-blank, unpadded string for provider/venue/instrument/ref fields
directive §18: the deterministic T1 identity algorithm is B5-I16; the envelope field is therefore Optional and no ID is ever generated
opaque id only; the registry and resolver are B5-I02/I03, and there is no UNKNOWN_CONTRACT or other placeholder value
directive §19: no generation writer, manifest, atomic publication or checksum
naming a version is not resolving it; no registry exists at B5-I01

validation_laws: naive datetimes refused; every present clock normalized to UTC (bloc_5/02 §18 inv.1)
interval_end_at >= interval_start_at (the only universally valid ordering)
interval bounds require an explicit interval_time_convention (bloc_05/02 §7)
interval bounds require an explicit interval_closed; None is not a declaration
market_available_at requires an availability_basis
market_available_at refused with availability_basis=UNKNOWN (bloc_05/02 §5)
no ordering assumed between distinct clocks (bloc_05/02 §6 published_at < effective_at stays representable)
models.note: All nine frozen canonical clocks are distinct Optional fields. None is derived at B5-I01, so none is required: a forced value would be fabrication. This container carries NO field that fills one clock from another.

validation_laws: native_field_name must not be blank
source_unit_contract=UNIT_EVIDENCE_DECLARED requires native_unit_evidence
source_unit_contract=NO_UNIT_FIELDS forbids native_unit_evidence
both absent stays HISTORICAL_UNIT_CONTRACT_ABSENT, a third distinct state (bloc_04/I17 §4.7)
unit truth carried by the accepted Bloc 4 SourceUnitEvidence object, not re-implemented
models.note: There is NO normalized_value / canonical_value / notional / USD field on this model at all, so native truth cannot be overwritten by a canonical value: the separation is structural. Dimensionless families (funding, basis, positioning) carry a value with no unit evidence and an explicit NO_UNIT_FIELDS declaration.

validation_laws: all eight frozen dimensions required; none has a default
models.note: A defaulted quality dimension is a claim. 'Not determined' must be declared as UNKNOWN rather than defaulting to something healthy. No aggregate score exists: Bloc 6 may read these components but must not overwrite them (bloc_05/07 §6).

validation_laws: quality_flags must be in canonical NormalizationQualityFlag declaration order, duplicate-free
lineage_state must agree with exactly one matching lineage flag
NORMALIZED / PARTIALLY_NORMALIZED require contract_instance_id (bloc_05/01 §2.5, F3)
each BLOCKED_* status requires exactly its own typed missingness cause
QUARANTINED requires missingness_reason=QUARANTINED
NORMALIZED must not carry a missingness reason
QUARANTINED requires quarantine_reason, non-empty quarantine_evidence_refs and a non-blank quarantine_remediation (bloc_05/05 §20)
quarantine metadata refused on a non-quarantined row
NORMALIZED / PARTIALLY_NORMALIZED require at least one native value (bloc_05/07 F12)
NORMALIZED / PARTIALLY_NORMALIZED require the four registry/methodology versions
no BLOCKING_QUALITY_FLAGS member may accompany a canonical status
LINEAGE_BROKEN is blocking regardless of the claimed status (bloc_05/05 §11)
quarantine_evidence_refs must be duplicate-free
identity_quality=VERIFIED requires contract_instance_id
lineage_quality VERIFIED/ACCEPTABLE_WITH_FLAGS contradicts lineage_state=LINEAGE_BROKEN
unit_quality=VERIFIED contradicts UNIT_CONVERSION_BLOCKED or STABLECOIN_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE
time_quality=VERIFIED contradicts an unverified/unknown time flag or an absent/UNKNOWN availability basis
semantic_quality=VERIFIED contradicts SEMANTICS_UNVERIFIED
extra fields refused (extra='forbid')
models.note: Deliberately named T1BaseEnvelope, not the frozen T1ObservationEnvelope: the frozen envelope also carries economic_contract_id, canonical_asset_id, normalization_methodology_id/_version and replay_eligibility, owned by B5-I02/I09/I06. The full name stays unexported until the composite is complete so nothing can mistake this base layer for the finished contract. Fields that cannot yet be truthfully populated are Optional, and t1_record_id is absent by default because no deterministic identity exists at B5-I01.

explicit_absences.no_canonical_numeric_field: no normalized_value, canonical_value, notional, base_quantity, usd or usd_equivalent field exists on any B5-I01 model
explicit_absences.no_stablecoin_equivalence: no field name contains 'usd' or 'fiat'; no default implies 1:1
explicit_absences.no_collapsed_source_field: no source/source_id/source_venue/provider_venue field re-merges provider and venue
explicit_absences.no_missing_boolean: no *_missing / has_* / missing field; absence is always a typed MissingnessReason
explicit_absences.no_generated_identity: no wall-clock read, no hash, no uuid, no ID derivation in model construction
explicit_absences.no_replay_eligibility: belongs to B5-I06; nothing claims a replay verdict at B5-I01
explicit_absences.no_canonical_asset_or_economic_contract: belongs to B5-I02; the base envelope fabricates no economic grouping
